about_the_game:
The Beauty of Scale

Starting with a modest container and basic cubes, you'll progress through orders of magnitude. What begins as merging individual cubes evolves into managing thousands of entities, filling containers that dwarf their predecessors by factors of millions. The game's visual representation of exponential growth creates moments of genuine awe as you witness the scale of your progression.

Interconnected Progression

Exponential Merge features multiple reset layers—Prestige and Rebirth—each offering different strategic considerations and permanent bonuses. Rather than simple number inflation, these systems create meaningful decisions about timing and resource allocation. Every action feeds into multiple progression paths: cube merging generates fragments for upgrades, reaching capacity limits produces compression currency, and battle victories yield amplifiers for permanent improvements.

Strategic Depth

The game presents constant optimization puzzles. How should you distribute your Cube Essence across upgrades? When is the optimal moment to trigger a Super Merge? Should you push for one more prestige or rebirth now for better multipliers? These decisions matter, as your choices compound over time—much like the exponential growth at the game's heart.

Content That Scales With You

Challenge containers provide endgame goals with scaling difficulty and rewards. The battle system offers an orthogonal progression path that enhances your main gameplay. With over 200 upgrades spread across multiple systems, plus upcoming crafting and equipment features, there's always a new optimization to discover or goal to pursue.

Why Exponential Merge Works

Unlike many incrementals that rely solely on bigger numbers, Exponential Merge grounds its progression in satisfying mechanics and visual feedback. Watching cubes merge in cascading chains, seeing containers fill to completion, and breaking through to new scales of magnitude—these moments create a gameplay loop that's both relaxing and engaging.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard sound device
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: High-performance audio device
  • VR Support: Not supported

short_description: Exponential Merge is an incremental game that transforms exponential growth into a tangible, visual experience. At its core, you merge cubes to fill containers—but this simple premise unfolds into a rich ecosystem of interconnected systems that reward strategic planning and optimization.
